metadata.title: Maximum Diversity and Support Transitions on Disks and Three-Dimensional Balls
metadata.abstract: For the similarity kernel $e^{-|x-y|}$, we determine the probability measure of maximum diversity on every planar disk and three-dimensional ball, answering a question of Leinster and Roff. In each dimension the measure is uniform on the boundary up to a threshold. Above it, the support is a closed central ball and the outer sphere, separated by a mass-free annulus. In dimensions two and three, their conjecture of finitely many supporting spheres therefore holds only up to the respective threshold. We obtain the measure explicitly up to one scalar root in three dimensions and through Fredholm integral equations and a scalar contact equation in the plane. Computations in dimensions four and five suggest that interior supporting spheres appear one at a time.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 对相似性核 e^(−|x−y|)，作者确定任意平面圆盘和三维球上最大 diversity 概率测度：半径低于某阈值时为边界均匀分布，超过阈值后支撑为中心闭球加外球面，中间隔无质量环带。三维解可表示到一个标量求根，二维由 Fredholm 积分方程及标量接触方程描述。
techniques: 核能量型概率测度优化
支撑集相变及接触条件
analysis.breakthrough: 回答 Leinster–Roff 的问题，并表明二、三维中有限多个支撑球面的猜想仅在各自阈值以内成立，阈值以上出现实心中心支撑。
analysis.limitations: 四、五维逐个出现内部支撑球面的现象只是计算暗示，不是已证明分类。二维解的积分方程描述不等于初等闭式；需保留指定核与维数。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 核测度优化和度量空间大小理论的相关结果，与曲率分析联系较间接。
